blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Each program is packaged with the source files and associated assets required for execution in its declared environment, along with available descriptions and verification records. Second, we develop the 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent directed acyclic graph framework for generating and refining 3D content. It uses execution checks, spatial measurements, and visual feedback to automatically evaluate and revise generated programs without human feedback during generation. Third, we conduct systematic empirical studies of 3D coding, establishing baselines with fine-tuned open models and deriving practical guidance through component-level analyses of our harness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that fine-tuning on our dataset significantly improves the 3D coding capabilities of open-source models. Notably, our 3DCodeVerse harness achieves a 90% win rate against Claude Design (3D Object) in pairwise human evaluations, when both are utilized by Claude Opus 5.5.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了3DCodeVerse,一个研究生态系统,它使编码剂能够大规模地创建可编辑和可核查的3D内容. 3DCodeVerse包含可执行的3D代码的大规模高质量数据集,用于空间推理和自动化验证的编码工具,以及3D编码实用指南. 首先,我们构建了3DCodeVerse-2M,一个由独立3D可执行代码组成的大规模编译数据集. 我们通过收集开源数据,转换专门表述,以及用编码代理生成新程序来建立这个工具。 每个程序都装有在其申报环境中执行所需的源文件和相关资产以及现有的描述和核查记录。 第二,我们开发出3DCodeVerse Harness,这是一个多剂定向的循环图框架,用于生成和精炼3D内容. 它利用执行检查,空间测量,和视觉反馈,在生成过程中自动评价和修改生成的程序而无需人类反馈. 第三,我们对三维编码进行系统的经验性研究,确定基线,采用经过微调的开放模型,并通过对我们的利用情况进行组件层面的分析,获得实际指导。 广泛的实验表明,我们数据集的微调可大大提高开源模型的3D编码能力. 值得注意的是,我们的3DCodeVerse控制带在Claude Design(3D Object)的双向人类评价中实现了90%的胜率,而Claude Opus 5.5则使用了两者。

blocks.en:
3D coding offers a promising approach to 3D creation by using executable programs to construct 3D geometry, define articulated motion, compose scenes, and generate graphics effects ( Raistrick et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
Unlike typical 2D generation workflows ( Chang et al., 2025 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ) , code-based 3D generation produces structured, executable content that users can edit, reuse, compose, and inspect.
These properties enable scalable, controllable 3D modeling for diverse applications.
Recent advances in language models and coding agents further automate this process, allowing users to create complex 3D content through text instructions ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
3D编码通过使用可执行程序来构建3D几何,定义清晰的运动,作曲场景,并产生图形效果(Raistrick等,2023;Hu等,2024;Zhou等,2026),为3D创建提供了一个很有希望的方法.
与典型的2D生成工作流程不同(Chang等,2025;Ho等,2020;Yuan等,2025;Yuan等,2024),基于代码的3D生成可执行内容,用户可以编辑,再用,作曲,并检查.
这些属性可以使多种应用的可伸缩,可控的3D模型化.
语言模型和编码代理最近的进步使这一过程进一步自动化,使得用户可以通过文本指令创建复杂的3D内容(Sun等,2023;Yin等,2026.).

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, shared infrastructure for developing and evaluating 3D coding systems across environments remains limited.
Existing resources address complementary aspects of 3D coding: DeepCAD and BlenderLLM provide supervision for CAD construction and Blender scripting ( Wu et al., 2021 ; Du et al., 2024 ) ; SceneCraft and VIGA refine generated content using visual feedback ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) ; and Articraft combines a specialized SDK with a harness for articulated asset generation ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
However, these resources remain fragmented across tasks and environments.
As shown in Table 1 , existing datasets primarily focus on static or articulated objects, while harnesses vary in their support for visual assessment and automated corpus construction.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但开发和评价各种环境的三维编码系统的共享基础设施仍然有限。
现有资源涉及3D编码的互补方面:DeepCAD和BlenderLLM为CAD的建设和Blender脚本制作提供监督(Wu等,2021;Du等,2024;SceneCraft和VIGA利用视觉反馈改进生成的内容(Hu等,2024;Yin等,2026;Articraft结合了专门的SDK与一种能清晰地生成资产的工具(Zhou等,2026)。
然而,这些资源在任务和环境上仍然支离破碎。
如表1所示,现有的数据集主要侧重于静态物体或已发光物体,而利用方式则在支持视觉评估和自动实体构造方面各不相同。

blocks.en:
To bridge these gaps, we introduce 3DCodeVerse (Figure 1 ), an open-source foundational framework for learning and scaling 3D coding through a large-scale executable code corpus and a 3D code generation harness.
We first build 3DCodeVerse -2M, a unified corpus of executable 3D programs spanning static objects, articulated assets, scenes, and graphics.
Rather than simply aggregating existing datasets, we systematically convert heterogeneous 3D representations into reusable source code and remove dependencies on specialized or unavailable libraries.
For example, we translate DeepCAD construction sequences into CadQuery programs and inline Articraft geometry routines while preserving URDF articulation specifications.
Each program is paired with its associated assets, textual descriptions, provenance, and available verification signals.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了3DCodeVerse(图1),这是一个开源基础框架,通过一个大型可执行代码集和一个3D代码生成工具来学习和缩放3D编码.
我们首先建造3DCDE Verse -2M,是一组可执行的3D程序,涵盖静态物体,被拼接的资产,场景,和图形.
我们不是简单地汇总现有的数据集,而是系统地将不同的三维表达式转换成可重复使用的源代码,并去除对专门或不可用的库的依赖.
例如,我们将 DeepCAD 构造序列翻译为 CadQuery 程序和内置 Articraft 几何常规,同时保留 URDF 表达规格.
每个程序都与其相关资产、文字说明、出处和可用的核查信号相配。

blocks.en:
We further develop 3DCodeVerse Harness, a 3D code generation harness for synthesizing and refining complex 3D programs from text, images, or videos.
The harness decomposes multi-component projects into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of coding and assembly tasks, allowing multiple agents to develop and integrate source files in a structured manner.
Generated programs are executed and rendered, after which an independent judge agent evaluates the outputs against explicit acceptance criteria.
Complementary spatial checks detect structural inconsistencies and prevent visually plausible but geometrically invalid solutions from receiving high scores.
The resulting feedback is then converted into localized repair objectives, enabling repeated execution–evaluation–revision cycles without human intervention.
Through this iterative process, the harness supports inference-time scaling to complex projects containing thousands of lines of code.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步发展了 3DCodeVerse Harness,一种3D代码生成工具,用于从文本、图像或视频中合成和完善复杂的3D程序。
牵引装置将多元件项目分解成一个定向的循环图(DAG)来进行编码和组装任务,使多元件能够有条理地开发和整合源文件.
产生方案得到执行和提供,然后由独立法官根据明确的接受标准评价产出。
补充空间检查发现结构不一致,防止视似似但几何上无效的解决方案得到高分.
由此产生的反馈随后被转化为局部修复目标,从而能够在没有人类干预的情况下重复执行-评价-修订周期。
通过这个迭代过程,被接地支持推论时间缩放到包含上千行代码的复杂项目.

blocks.en:
Importantly, 3DCodeVerse Harness serves not only as an inference system but also as a data-generation engine.
By recording successful programs, failed attempts, targeted repairs, and preference comparisons, its execution traces provide supervision for both supervised fine-tuning and preference learning.
Together, 3DCodeVerse -2M and 3DCodeVerse Harness establish not only a reusable infrastructure for 3D coding, but also a closed loop connecting data construction, program synthesis, verification, refinement, and model improvement.
We further support this ecosystem with open models and reproducible training recipes.
Fine-tuning on 3DCodeVerse -2M substantially improves executable 3D code generation, reaching execution rates of 84.9% with a 9B model and 92.9% with a 27B model on 3DCodeBench .
Moreover, 3DCodeVerse Harness consistently improves generation quality across coding agents, yielding gains of 15.5–29.1 points over one-shot generation.
blocks.zh:
重要的是,3DCode Verse Harness不仅作为推断系统,而且作为数据生成引擎.
通过记录成功的方案、失败的尝试、有针对性的修复和偏好比较,其执行痕迹为有监督的微调和偏好学习提供了监督。
3DCodeVerse -2M和3DCode合在一起 Verse Harness不仅为3D编码建立了可重复使用的基础设施,而且还建立了闭环连接数据构建,程序合成,验证,完善,以及模型改进.
我们以开放模式和可再生的培训食谱进一步支持这一生态系统。
3DCodeVerse -2M的精细调整大大改善了可执行的3D代码生成,在3DCode Bench上达到84.9%的可执行率,在9B型上达到92.9%的可执行率.
此外, 3DCde 系统 Verse Harness 不断提高编码器的生成质量,比一发子弹的生成获得15.5-29.1分的收益。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Learning to generate 3D content as code benefits from supervision over its construction procedures.
DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Gallery expose CAD construction sequences, and Text2CAD connects such sequences to natural language ( Wu et al., 2021 ; Willis et al., 2021 ; Khan et al., 2024 ) .
This supervision has expanded to executable CadQuery and Blender programs for reconstruction and language-conditioned generation through BlendNet, CAD-Recode, CAD-Coder, and MeshCoder ( Du et al., 2024 ; Rukhovich et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) .
Complementary procedural resources broaden the content represented by code: Infinigen and its extensions generate assets and scenes ( Raistrick et al., 2023 ; Raistrick et al., 2024 ; Joshi et al., 2025 ) , while Shaders21k provides programs for procedural image synthesis ( Baradad et al., 2022 ) .
Existing benchmarks assess the resulting code generation, editing, and physics capabilities ( Alrashedy et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2026b ; Shen et al., 2026 ) .
However, our paper focuses on scaling executable supervision across these heterogeneous coding environments.
Our 3DCodeVerse-2M provides a million-scale training corpus spanning CAD, Blender, shaders, and browser graphics, with programs that are self-contained within their respective target runtimes.
Its construction combines curated existing sources with automated program generation and execution-based filtering, enabling continued data expansion for training open 3D coding models.

DeepCAD和Fusion 360 Gallery曝光了CAD构建序列,Text2CAD将这些序列与自然语言相接(Wu等,2021;Willis等,2021;Khan等,2024.
这种监督已经扩大到通过BlendNet、CAD-Recode、CAD-Coder和MeshCoder(Du等,2024;Rukhovich等,2025;Guan等,2026;Dai等,2026)可执行的CadQuery和Blender重建和语言条件生成程序。

它的构建将已整理出的现有源与自动程序生成和基于执行的过滤相结合,使得能够持续地扩展数据来培训开放的3D编码模型.

blocks.en:
Execution and feedback allow 3D coding agents to inspect and revise the content produced by their programs.
Systems such as 3D-GPT, SceneCraft, and LL3M establish language-driven planning and program generation for 3D modeling ( Sun et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) .
Executing and rendering these programs enables visual refinement, as explored by BlenderAlchemy, CADCodeVerify, and VIGA ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Alrashedy et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2026 ) .
Beyond rendered appearance, Articraft provides structured asset validation through a specialized SDK, while Bioinspired123D connects script quality control with a graph-based agentic workflow ( Luu & Buehler, 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
3DHarnessBench further studies how the observation and tool interfaces available to an agent affect 3D reconstruction ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
In contrast, our 3DCodeVerse harness provides a reusable execution and verification framework across coding backends, jointly supporting inference-time refinement and scalable training data curation.
Its multi-agent directed acyclic graph coordinates execution, rendering, spatial measurements, and structural checks across static and articulated objects, scenes, and visual effects.
The same framework equips coding agents with visual and programmatic feedback and serves as an automated data engine that generates, refines, and filters training programs without human feedback in the curation loop.
blocks.zh:
执行和反馈使3D编码代理能够检查并修改其程序所出的内容.
3D-GPT,SceneCraft,LL3M等系统为3D建模建立由语言驱动的规划和程序生成(Sun等,2023;Hu等,2024;Lu等,2025.).
如BlenderAlchemy、CADCodeVerify和VIGA所探讨的那样,执行和渲染这些方案有助于视觉改进(Huang等人,2024;Alrashedy等人,2025;Yin等人,2026)。
除了被渲染出外,Articraft通过专门的SDK提供结构化的资产验证,而Bioinspired123D将脚本质量控制与以图表为基础的代理工作流程相连接(Luu & Buehler, 2026b; Zhou等, 2026).

相比之下,我们的3DCodeVerse控制器提供了一个跨编码后端的可重复使用的执行和核查框架,共同支持推论时间的完善和可扩展的培训数据校正。
它的多剂引导环形图协调执行,渲染,空间测量,以及结构检查,跨越静态和被分解的物体,场景,和视觉效果.
同一框架为编码代理提供了可视性和程序反馈,并充当自动数据引擎,生成,精炼,过滤培训程序,而无需人类在目录循环中的反馈.

Public resources include Bioinspired3D ( Luu & Buehler, 2026a ) , 3DCodeBench ( Gao et al., 2026b ) , Thingiverse, Shadertoy ( Quilez & Jeremias, 2013 ) , CodePen animations (Animation2Code), and multi-file Three.js/React Three Fiber projects.

blocks.en:
Generating high-quality 3D programs often requires iterative refinement, but reliance on human feedback makes this process difficult to scale.
To address this bottleneck, we develop 3DCodeVerse Harness, a multi-agent framework that automates 3D code generation and refinement for data curation and agent-driven content creation (Figure 3 ).
It coordinates coding and assembly through a DAG and combines execution checks, spatial tools, and rubric-guided VLM judgments to identify defects and guide targeted revisions without human feedback.
Because the reliability of this feedback depends on how we configure its prompts, tools, and rubrics, we further refine the judge and generation workflow through an alternating development-time adversarial loop.

它通过DAG协调编码和组装,并结合执行检查,空间工具,以及由文字指导的VLM判断,以查明缺陷并指导没有人类反馈的定向修改.
因为这种反馈的可靠性取决于我们如何配置它的提示、工具和标题,所以我们通过一个交替的开发时间对抗循环来进一步完善判断和生成工作流程。

Within this graph, explicit file ownership allows independent coding tasks to be carried out concurrently by sub-agents.
Once their prerequisites are satisfied, assembly tasks integrate the resulting code, ultimately producing the initial program f ( 0 ) f^{(0)} for subsequent evaluation and feedback-driven refinement.

blocks.en:
Evaluation setup. We compare 3DCodeVerse against models with their native harnesses and Claude Design on 100 text-to-3D object prompts.
We further compare against native harnesses on articulated-object generation, 50 scene prompts, and 50 graphics prompts.
We evaluate generation quality using three metrics. Human Preference is the fraction of anonymized side-by-side comparisons won according to human evaluators, with ties split equally. VLM Preference is the fraction of the same comparisons won according to a VLM judge (Gemini 3.1 Pro), with ties split equally. Judge Score is Gemini 3.1 Pro’s overall rubric score, combining weighted criteria with defect penalties and score caps (0–100; failed generations receive a score of zero).
Following 3DCodeBench ( Gao et al., 2026b ) , we additionally report SigLIP-2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) text–image cosine similarity averaged over four views.
The evaluation judge is described in Appendix C.3 , and further evaluation details are in Appendix C.3 .

Main Results. Figure 4 shows a consistent pattern across backbones and tasks: outputs from the native harness are rarely preferred, while the same backbone within 3DCodeVerse Harness wins most comparisons.
On 3D objects, Human Preference for 3DCodeVerse Harness ranges from 69% to 89%, while Judge Score improves by 11–25 points.
The largest gains occur for the weaker models, including Gemini 3.8 Flash (61 to 87) and GPT-6 Luna (64 to 86).
Against Claude Design, which uses Claude Opus 5.5, 3DCodeVerse Harness with the same backbone is preferred in 90% of human comparisons and achieves a Judge Score of 88 versus 37.
The same pattern extends to articulated objects, scenes, and graphics, where Human Preference reaches 78–88%.
The agreement between human preference and rubric-based scores suggests that the gains are not specific to the VLM rubric used during refinement.

blocks.en:
We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) in LLaMA-Factory ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) on mixtures drawn from 3DCodeVerse -2M (Appendix C.1 ) and compare the resulting models with their respective pretrained checkpoints.
Evaluation spans 805 fixed tasks across six suites: 212 text-to-Blender tasks from 3DCodeBench ( Gao et al., 2026b ) and five test splits drawn from 3DCodeVerse -2M: Blender (103 procedural objects), CadQuery (200 mechanical parts from DeepCAD and Articraft), OpenSCAD (50 Thingiverse models), GLSL (200 Shadertoy shaders), and Three.js (40 single-object scenes).
Each task pairs a natural-language request with a reference program.
Executing the reference program produces the evaluation target: a mesh for the four 3D suites, a rendered frame for GLSL, and a page screenshot for Three.js.
All models receive the same request and per-dialect system prompt without examples, are decoded at T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 with one seed, and have every output executed in the dialect’s pinned runtime (Appendix C.3 ).
We report the execution rate (Table 2 ) and fidelity to the target (Table 6 ): F@0.05 between the generated and reference meshes, and DINOv2-L similarity between clay renders of the two meshes from four fixed views; failed programs score zero on both.
blocks.zh:
我们在LLaMA-Factory(郑等,2024年)中,对从3DCodeVerse -2M(附录C.1)抽取的混合物进行微调后,将Qune3.5-9B和Qune3.8-27B与LORA(Hu等,2021年)进行微调,并将得出的模型与各自经过预先训练的检查站进行比较。
评价涉及805个固定任务,涉及6个套间:212个从3DCde到Blender的任务 法官(Gao等人,2026年b)和从3DCode抽取的5个测试分数 Verse -2M: Blender (103个程序对象), CadQuery (由DeepCAD和Articraft提供的200个机械部件),OpenSCAD (50 Thingiverse models),GLSL (200 Shadertoy shaders),和Tree.js (40个单对象场景).
每个任务将一个自然语言请求与一个参考程序相配.
执行参考程序产生评价目标:四个3D套件的网格,GLSL的渲染框架,和Tree.js的页面截图.
所有模型都收到相同的请求,并且没有实例的每个分光系统提示,在 T = 0.7 T = 0.7 分出一个种子时被解码,并在方言被绑定的运行时间(Appendix C.3 )中实现每个输出.
我们报告执行率(表2)和对目标的忠诚度(表6):F@0.05 生成和参考网格之间,而DINov2-L 粘土之间的相似性使两个网格从四个固定视图中产生;失败的程序对两者都得分为零。

blocks.en:
Before fine-tuning, none of the programs generated by Qwen3.5-9B on 3DCodeBench execute successfully; most fail immediately by calling scene-clearing operators unavailable in Blender 5.
After fine-tuning on 3DCodeVerse -2M, execution rises to 84.9% on 3DCodeBench , 90.3% on Blender, and 98.5% on CadQuery, with additional gains of 36.0 and 23.0 points on OpenSCAD and GLSL (Table 2 ).
Qwen3.8-27B starts from a stronger baseline but shows the same trend: fine-tuning raises execution on 3DCodeBench from 51.9% to 92.9% (+41.0 points), on Blender to 93.2% (+18.4), and on CadQuery to 98.5% (+33.0).
blocks.zh:
在微调前, 由 3DCode Bench 上的 Quen3.5- 9B 生成的程序都没有成功执行; 大多数程序会立即通过调用 Blender 5 中无法使用的场景清除操作器而失败 。
在3DCodeVerse -2M上微调后,3DCode Bench上的执行率上升至84.9%,Blender上的执行率上升至90.3%,CadQuery上的执行率上升至98.5%,OpenSCAD和GLSL上增加36.0分和23.0分(表2).
Quen3.8-27 (中文(简体) ). B从更强的基线开始,但呈现出同样的趋势:微调后将3DCode Bench的执行率从51.9%提高到92.9%(+41.0分),将Blender提高到93.2%(+18.4),将CadQuery提高到98.5%(+33.0分).

blocks.en: 5.3 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 定性分析

blocks.en:
For matched prompts and backbones, Figure 6 (a) shows that 3DCodeVerse Harness produces more complete structures and finer details, such as the phoenix’s legs and nest and the piano’s interior.
Figure 6 (b) shows how successive refinement rounds correct specific defects, improving the phoenix’s facial feathers, attaching the stool legs to the seat, and reducing block artifacts in the neon shader.
Together, these examples show that automated feedback can correct both structural and appearance defects without additional human instructions.
blocks.zh:
对于匹配的提示和主干线,图6(a)显示3DCode Verse Harness产生了更完整的结构和更细微的细节,如凤凰的腿和巢以及钢琴的内部.
图6(b)显示接连不断的精细弹如何纠正具体的缺陷,改进了凤凰的面部羽毛,将凳子腿绑在座位上,并减少了霓虹花荫道的块状文物.
这些例子共同表明,自动反馈可以同时纠正结构缺陷和外观缺陷,而无需额外的人类指令.

blocks.en: 6 Applications of 3D coding
blocks.zh: 6 三维编码的应用

blocks.en: Figure 7: Applications. Code renders from our harness guide video generation with Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 for robot manipulation scenes (top) and Seedance 2.5 for a GPT-6 Astra scene (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图7:应用。 代码由我们使用双子座Omni Flash 1.1为机器人操控场景(上)制作的引导视频生成,而种子2.5为GPT-6 Astra场景(下方)制作.

blocks.en:
Robotics. 3D coding enables the construction of articulated assets and scenes with explicit geometry and physical constraints for simulated robot tasks.
Programs encode rigid-link geometry, joint axes, and joint limits as editable parameters, supporting programmatic checks and controlled variation of object dimensions, articulation, and initial poses.
These task instances can be executed in simulations to generate robot interactions and observations.
To provide a preliminary evaluation, we import an articulated asset validated and exported with 3DCodeVerse tools into MuJoCo and compare rendered observations with frozen UWM ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) predictions across 12 cases spanning two assets, two contact states, and three control sequences, using complete scene state for rendering and image history with matched robot commands for UWM.
Code renders and their UWM VAE reconstructions each pass a fixed door-and-handle geometry check in 12/12 outputs, versus 7/36 UWM predictions.
These results show that 3D code can help generate articulated assets and scenes for robotics simulation with explicit geometry and physical constraints.
blocks.zh:
机器人学. 3D编码可以构建有清晰几何和物理约束的清晰资产和场景来进行模拟机器人任务.
程序将刚性-链接几何,联合轴和联合限制编码为可编辑参数,支持程序检查和对象维度的可控变异,表达,和初始形式.
这些任务实例可以在模拟中执行,以产生机器人的相互作用和观测.
为了进行初步评估,我们把一个经过验证并用3DCodeVerse工具出口到MuJoCo, 并将所给出的观察与冻结的UWM(Zhu等,2025年)的预测相比较, 涉及两个资产、两个接触国和三个控制序列的12个案例, 利用完整的场景状态进行渲染和图像历史与UWM的相匹配的机器人命令。
编码使UWM VAE的重建通过12/12输出的固定门和手几何检查,而UWM预测为7/36。
这些结果显示,3D代码可以帮助生成清晰几何和物理约束的机器人模拟的清晰资产和场景.

blocks.en:
Video generation. 3D coding provides an editable interface for controlling the spatial and temporal conditions of video generation.
Programs specify scene layout, object articulation and motion, and camera trajectories.
We render generated 3D scenes using programs and harness them as reference videos, using the full sequences to condition Gemini Omni Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) and Seedance 2.5 ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) .
The rendered videos supply spatial and temporal guidance, while the video models are used to refine visual appearance.
We present paired reference and generated frames to examine how the specified layout, object motion, and camera trajectories are preserved.
This application connects explicit scene programs with video synthesis.
blocks.zh:
视频生成. 三维编码为控制视频生成的时空条件提供了一个可编辑的界面.
程序指定了场景布局,物体表达和运动,以及相机轨迹.
我们利用程序来渲染生成的3D场景, 并将其作为参考视频,
提供的视频提供时空指导,而视频模型则用于改进视觉外观。
我们提出了对齐的参考和生成的帧,以审查如何保存指定的布局、物体运动和相机轨迹。
这个应用程序将明确的场景程序与视频合成相接.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present 3DCodeVerse, an open ecosystem that provides a shared foundation for 3D coding through datasets, a reusable harness, and open model baselines.
The dataset brings together programs across coding environments with descriptions, associated assets, and available quality records.
The harness combines execution, spatial checks, and visual judgment to support iterative generation without human feedback during a run, while retaining the resulting programs and revisions for data curation.
Experiments demonstrate the utility of the data for training open models and the benefits of the harness for existing coding agents.
We will release the datasets, harness, models, and training recipes to support further research on 3D generation through code.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了3DCodeVerse,这是一个开放的生态系统,它为通过数据集进行3D编码提供了一个共享的基础,是一个可再利用的带子,以及开放的模型基线.
数据集汇集了跨越编码环境的程序,并附有描述,相关资产,以及现有的质量记录.
该套接力结合了执行,空间检查,以及视觉判断,支持在运行过程中没有人类反馈的迭代生成,同时保留由此产生的程序和数据校正.
实验表明数据对培训开放模型的效用以及对现有编码剂加以利用的好处。
我们将发布数据集,利用,模型,以及培训食谱,支持通过代码对3D生成进行进一步研究.

Figure 8: Components and model roles. A planner, a judge, and a coding agent are configured modularly per run; the harness orchestrates stage progression, iterative refinement, and candidate selection while providing deterministic spatial tools, verification gates, multi-view renderers, and rubric aggregation.

blocks.en:
3DCodeVerse Harness spans four generative tracks—static objects, articulated objects, 3D scenes, and procedural graphics—backed by seven isolated language runtimes: three for static objects (Blender Python, CadQuery, and Three.js), one each for articulated mechanisms (URDF with Blender-authored links) and scenes (Three.js), and two for graphics (GLSL and moderngl ).
Each runtime specifies a strict file layout, static lint rules, a sandboxed build wrapper, canonical export formats, and a deterministic render driver, while sharing unified coordinate frames, metric units, camera rigs, and geometric tolerances.
blocks.zh:
3DCodeVerse Harness横跨了四个基因轨道——静态对象,被拼接的对象,3D场景,以及程序图形——由七个孤立的语言运行时间支撑:三个静态对象(Blender Python, CadQuery,和Tree.js),一个分别用于被拼接的机制(URDF有 Blender 作者链接)和场景(Tree.js),两个用于图形(GLSL和现代gl).
每次运行时间都指定一个严格的文件布局,静态林特规则,一个沙盒式的建筑包装器,条形导出格式,以及决定式渲染驱动程序,同时共享统一的坐标框,度量单位,相机钻机,以及几何可容性.

blocks.en:
Each run decouples structural planning, code synthesis, and visual evaluation into three pluggable roles: a planner , a coding agent , and a vision–language judge (Figure 8 ).
The planner and judge operate through a unified API interface, while the coding agent executes inside an isolated workspace equipped with the harness’s spatial tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), alongside a single-shot mode that requests a complete file envelope through direct API calls.
Every round commits raw source code from which meshes and renders are deterministically regenerated; boilerplate infrastructure (camera rigging, coordinate conversion, URDF composition, scene assembly, and shader headers) resides in the harness, and verification proceeds strictly from fast programmatic gates to blind VLM judging.
blocks.zh:
每个都运行脱钩结构规划,代码合成,和视觉评价三个可插入的角色:一个规划者,一个编码代理,和一个视觉-语言法官(图8).
策划者和判断者通过统一的API接口运行,而编码代理则通过"模型背景协议"(MCP)在一个配备了被带空间工具的被隔离的工作空间内执行,同时使用通过直接API呼叫请求完整文件信封的一发模式.
每一回合都使用原始源代码,从中生成和制作的源代码是决定性的再生;锅炉平板基础设施(相机操纵、坐标转换、URDF组成、场景组装和遮蔽头)都位于电源上,严格地从快速程序闸口到盲目VLM判断进行核查。

blocks.zh: A.2 规划和工作图

blocks.en:
Figure 9: From structural plan to file scopes and coding sessions , illustrated on the recorded trajectory of § A.6 .
The planner decomposes the prompt into named parts with metric bounding boxes, materials, attachment relations, and an acceptance checklist; each target maps to its owned source files, and refinement tasks sharing files are grouped into file-disjoint sessions.

blocks.en:
The planner translates an open-ended request into a schema-validated structural plan: named parts with metric bounding boxes, materials, symmetry, and attachment topology for static objects; a kinematic tree with typed joints, axes, pivots, limits, and acyclic affine mimic couplings ( q j = m j ​ q i + b j q_{j}=m_{j}q_{i}+b_{j} ) for articulated mechanisms; spatial zones, modular assets, effects, and authored cameras for scenes; and render passes, uniforms, and temporal dynamics for graphics.
Each plan carries an acceptance checklist binding items to an evidence modality (measurement, visual inspection, probe, or joint sweep) and a priority ( must or should ), supplemented by canonical rules that normalize kinematic conventions and enforce requested dimensions ( ± 5 % \pm 5\% ), triangle budgets, grounding, and temporal motion.
blocks.zh:
规划者将一个无限制的请求翻译成一个有计划验证的结构计划: 命名部分,其中包含测量边框,材料,对称性,以及静态物体的附属地貌; 动能树有打出关节,斧子,活口,极限,并有环状外缘相仿相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 q_{j}=m}j}q_{i}+i}+b_{j}j}j}j}j}j}j}),用于清晰的机理;空间区域,模块化资产,效果,以及用于场景的由作者制作的相机;并渲染出相传,制服,以及图形的时间动态.
每个计划都包含一个对证据模式(测量、目视检查、探测或联合扫描)和优先权(必须或应该)具有约束力的验收清单项目,并辅之以使动能公约正常化并强制要求的维度(±5%\pm 5+%),三角预算,地平面和时间运动。

blocks.en:
Planning executes as a structured-output call with a token budget scaled to the target part count.
Range or formatting violations are repaired in-context, whereas a degenerate kinematic hierarchy referencing undeclared links triggers a clean context reset from the original request (§ C.5 ).
blocks.zh:
规划是作为结构化产出呼吁执行的,象征性预算按比例计算目标部分。
范围或格式化的违反情况被校正成文,而退化的动能等级参照未申报的链接则触发从最初请求中重新设置干净的上下文(第C.5节)。

blocks.en:
Each runtime maps plan targets to strict file-ownership scopes (per-part modules plus an assembly entry file for Blender and Three.js objects; a single program for CadQuery, URDF, and graphics; and per-zone and per-asset modules for scenes), and writes outside a session’s scope are reverted between Git commits.
Objects with eight or more top-level parts in modular languages are synthesized via scoped sessions over attachment subtrees of at most three parts—each supplied with the planned bounding boxes of adjacent parts—followed by an assembly session (Figure 9 ).
During refinement, tasks that share files are grouped into connected components and dispatched as file-disjoint sessions, bounding per-session context and preventing cross-part regressions (§ C.5 ), while best-of- N N candidates and scene assets run concurrently in isolated workspaces.
blocks.zh:
每个运行时的地图计划目标为严格的文件所有权范围(每部分模块加上Blender和Tree.js对象的组装条目文件;CadQuery、URDF和图形的单一程序;以及场景的每个区和每个资产模块),在Git承诺之间重回会话范围外的写作。
模块语言中具有8个或8个以上顶级部分的物体,在最多3个部分的附属子树上通过范围会议合成,每个部分配有规划的相邻部分的相接框,然后是组装会话(图9)。
在完善期间,共享文件的任务被分组为连接的组件,并作为文件不关联的会话发送,将每个会话的上下文捆绑在一起并预防跨部分回归(§C.5),而最优N候选人和场景资产同时运行在孤立的工作空间.

blocks.en:
Every agent workspace is provisioned with a standardized instruction specification containing the runtime invariants, track-specific tool schemas, and language contracts.
Each task prompt supplies the user request, coordinate-frame conventions, the language cookbook, the structural plan formatted as exact metric tables with its acceptance checklist, and the verification protocol (requiring a clean build followed by spatial measurement or probing).
Single-shot prompts inline the code skeleton and request a complete file envelope in a single response.
blocks.zh:
每个代理工作区都有一个标准化的指令规格,其中包含运行时间变化因素、田径专用工具计划以及语言合同。
每项任务都及时提供用户请求、协调框架公约、语言烹饪本、结构计划格式化为精确的、带有验收清单的计量表以及核查协议(需要清理后再进行空间测量或探测)。
单发提示将代码骨架内入并请求在一个单发回复中有一个完整的文件信封.

blocks.en: A.3 Spatial tools and deterministic gates
blocks.zh: A.3 空间工具和确定性大门

blocks.en:
Figure 10: Observations, deterministic gates, and authoring-frame feedback. A measured geometric defect is returned as a structured negative verdict rather than a protocol error (left); a single verification routine serves simultaneously as an interactive agent tool, an end-of-round gate, and a generator of prioritized revision tasks (middle).
Right: baseline-round diagnostics from § A.6 , with corrective translation vectors projected directly into the agent’s native authoring frame.
blocks.zh:
图10:观测、确定性门和作者框架反馈。 被测量到的几何缺陷作为结构化的否定判断返回,而不是协议出错(左);一个单一的验证常规同时作为交互式代理工具,一个圆末门,以及一个优先修订任务的生成器(中间).
右:从§A.6进行基线圆形诊断,将校正的翻译向量直接投射到剂的原生作者框中.

blocks.en:
Every tool response separates the semantic verification verdict ( pass / fail ) from the tool execution status .
A detected mesh collision or build failure is returned as a valid observation leading with a structured fail verdict; only an internal tool crash sets the MCP protocol error flag, preventing commercial coding agents from entering degenerate transport-retry loops (§ C.5 ).
Tool responses bound text length and image resolution, attaching diagnostic renders specifically when a check identifies actionable geometric defects.
blocks.zh:
每个工具响应将语义验证判断(通过/失败)与工具执行状态相分离. .
被检测到的网格相撞或构建失败被作为有效的观测结果返回,并带有结构化的故障判断;只有内部工具崩溃设置了MCP协议出错标记,防止商业编码代理进入已退化的运回回循环(§C.5).
工具响应绑定了文本长度和图像分辨率,附加了诊断方法,在检查中识别出可操作几何缺陷时,会特别产生.

blocks.en:
Following each successful build, the track pipeline executes its deterministic gates.
Gate errors compile into high-priority revision tasks with numerical fix hints and impose hard upper bounds on the round’s rubric score, while warnings are surfaced to the judge.
Conversely, passing a deterministic gate vetoes contradictory visual defect claims from the VLM judge (§ A.4 ).
In the connectivity gate, the ground-contacting component with the largest face count defines the primary support structure, and any disconnected component is reported alongside its nearest supported neighbour and the exact 3D translation vector that closes the gap.
A contact ledger tracks all planned part attachments with their measured clearances while enforcing structural support at the global assembly level.
The contract gate verifies built part counts, orientations, and bounding-box extents against the structural plan within per-axis tolerances.
blocks.zh:

Pre-round stages are cached, whereas every round executes fresh through a fixed verification chain: code synthesis, build with bounded repair, geometric measurement, deterministic gates, multi-view rendering, VLM judgment, and Git archival.
A failed build triggers up to three targeted repair sessions supplied with the error location, traceback, lint diagnostics, and relevant cookbook snippets, and every completed round is committed with a journal entry of its telemetry, verdicts, renders, and token usage.
Refinement tasks are compiled from the preceding round in strict priority order—deterministic gate errors with numerical fix hints, then unverified mandatory checklist items, then the judge’s perceptual instructions—and deduplicated by part and defect category.
At most six tasks are dispatched per round, and truncation applies only to perceptual suggestions, so gate errors and mandatory items are never dropped; reference-conditioned runs append a silhouette task whenever outline IoU falls below 0.60 0.60 .

Figure 12 traces a complete run for the prompt “a three-legged wooden stool” on the Three.js runtime under the economy profile.
The planner decomposes the stool into seven parts (a circular seat slab, three splayed legs, and three through-tenon wedges) with eleven checklist items, including four signature structural features.
In the baseline round ( t = 0 t=0 ), the initial script builds, but deterministic gates identify multiple structural violations: the connectivity gate detects three wedge–seat interpenetrations ( ≈ 22 \approx 22 mm) and six disconnected parts floating up to 212 212 mm from the support component; two legs exceed their planned bounding-box tolerances; and the mesh contains only 1,572 1{,}572 triangles against a detail floor of 2,450 2{,}450 , yielding a composite score of 0.410 0.410 ( 0.59 0.59 weighted criterion mean minus 0.18 0.18 in defect penalties).
The harness compiles nine prioritized revision tasks—eight from deterministic gate errors with exact authoring-frame translation vectors and one from the footprint specification—and dispatches them across eight file-disjoint sessions.
By Round 1, every structural defect is resolved: all seven parts form a single ground-supported assembly with nine verified contacts, lifting the score by + 0.434 +0.434 to 0.844 0.844 .
Round 2 addresses the remaining geometric and metric refinements—carving recessed mortise slots, chamfering the slab rims, and increasing leg splay—expanding mesh detail to 11,052 11{,}052 triangles and reaching a score of 0.933 0.933 (bounded by the graded checklist cap of 0.6 + 0.4 × 5 / 6 0.6+0.4\times 5/6 for a 0.34 0.34 m vs. 0.38 0.38 m base diameter).
The complete trajectory finishes in 21 21 model calls, 4.0 4.0 active minutes, and $0.74, and the output selector packages Round 2.

blocks.en:
Scene synthesis executes a staged hierarchical pipeline prior to the main refinement loop (Figure 14 a).
Individual scene assets (up to eight, or four under tight budget thresholds) follow a progressive compute-escalation policy: each asset begins with a fast single-shot draft and deterministic check, escalating to a full interactive agent session only if automated repair does not resolve all findings; Blender-built hero assets additionally undergo VLM evaluation with a monotonic quality gate that retains a revision pass only if it strictly improves the asset score.
Environmental terrains and spatial zone layouts are built concurrently, followed by a unified cross-zone composition session and deterministic scene-graph assembly.
To guarantee timely completion on complex prompts, pre-round staging is bounded at 55 % 55\% of the wall-clock budget, dynamically switching remaining pre-round stages to fast single-shot synthesis once reached.
Scene gates enforce asset grounding and collision bounds, runtime console cleanliness, per-camera exposure and framing coverage, inter-frame animation motion, asset utilization, and a 15,000 15{,}000 draw-call budget across up to ten authored and overview camera views.

blocks.en:
DeepCAD provides 178,238 178{,}238 raw sketch–extrusion command sequences rather than executable programs ( Wu et al., 2021 ) .
Our deterministic compiler translates each command sequence into a self-contained CadQuery script: 174,981 174{,}981 sequences compile ( 98.2 % 98.2\% ), 174,177 174{,}177 produce valid watertight solids ( 97.7 % 97.7\% ), and vector-level hashing removes 25.8 % 25.8\% exact geometric duplicates to yield 128,201 128{,}201 unique executable programs ( 71.9 % 71.9\% of raw sequences).
Geometric fidelity against the original solids, measured via voxel IoU at 48 3 48^{3} resolution, averages 0.985 0.985 , with 96.9 % 96.9\% of programs exceeding 0.90 0.90 (the remaining 1,114 1{,}114 programs are annotated with explicit fidelity metadata so downstream pipelines can apply custom thresholds).
Natural-language annotations from Text2CAD ( Khan et al., 2024 ) are paired with 125,162 125{,}162 programs under their original license terms, accompanied by four canonical views per solid.
Crucially, because the upstream DeepCAD split contains 3,230 3{,}230 duplicate geometry groups straddling its train and test partitions, our vector-and-mesh deduplication eliminates cross-split leakage across the CAD lineage.

Direct Preference Optimization (DPO; Rafailov et al. 2023 ) initializes from the merged SFT checkpoint and trains a rank- 16 16 LoRA ( α = 32 \alpha=32 ) for 2 2 epochs under sigmoid preference loss ( β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 , learning rate 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} ).
The sequence context length is set to 8,192 8{,}192 tokens for 9 9 B runs and 4,096 4{,}096 tokens for 27 27 B runs to fit single-device memory bounds under data-parallel training.

Training examples are formatted as ShareGPT multi-turn conversations: a system prompt specifying the target dialect and output contract, a user turn containing the natural-language specification, and an assistant turn containing the complete executable program in a fenced code block.

To guarantee zero train–test leakage, all 212 212 3DCodeBench procedural factories, all 3,904 3{,}904 re-seeded instances derived from those factories, and all per-dialect evaluation splits are strictly held out; no training mixture shares a program or asset identifier with any evaluation task.

Figure 15 demonstrates smooth, stable convergence across all three regimes: no logged step exceeds 1.3 × 1.3\times the trailing 20 20 -step moving average, and all runs are entirely free of instability or divergence spikes.
Rapid initial adaptation occurs within the first quarter of the epoch—reducing cross-entropy from ≈ 0.60 {\approx}0.60 to 0.30 0.30 (Arm A) and 0.36 0.36 (Arms B and C)—followed by steady refinement to terminal smoothed losses of 0.274 0.274 (Arm A), 0.314 0.314 (Arm B), and 0.292 0.292 (Arm C), with Arm A stabilizing across the second half of the epoch ( 0.277 0.277 at mid-epoch to 0.274 0.274 at completion).
Together, the three arms highlight two complementary operating regimes of 3DCodeVerse -2M: Arm C ( 293 293 K unique instruction–program pairs, 647 647 steps) offers high sample efficiency for rapid adaptation, achieving a lower terminal loss than Arm B in one quarter of the optimization steps, whereas Arm A ( 1.99 1.99 M rows, 4,322 4{,}322 steps) leverages multi-caption and pass-level shader views to reinforce cross-representation alignment, achieving the lowest loss both at matched step budgets ( 0.275 0.275 vs. 0.316 0.316 at step 2,490 2{,}490 ) and at full convergence ( 0.274 0.274 ).

For open-model evaluations (§ 5.2 ), generated responses pass through a deterministic code extractor that strips reasoning blocks, collects fenced code blocks (including trailing unterminated blocks), and ranks candidates by dialect markers, fence annotations, and AST syntactic validity.
This extraction step is essential for pretrained reasoning checkpoints: with thinking enabled, 52 52 of 212 212 responses from the zero-shot 27 27 B model omit markdown fences and 74 74 place auxiliary snippets after the main program, whereas fine-tuned models adhere strictly to the single-block output contract ( 100 % 100\% single-fence compliance).
Extracted programs execute inside the dialect’s pinned runtime under a 300 300 s timeout.
Resulting meshes are exported to GLB, centred at the origin, normalized to unit maximum extent, uniformly sampled at 10,000 10{,}000 surface points, and evaluated via symmetric Chamfer- L 2 L_{2} distance and F-score at thresholds τ ∈ { 0.05 , 0.10 } \tau\in\{0.05,0.10\} (taking the best alignment across the four 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} yaw rotations; ground-truth reference scripts self-verify at Chamfer ≈ 0.016 \text{Chamfer}\approx 0.016 and F@0.05 ≈ 1.0 \text{F@0.05}\approx 1.0 ).

blocks.en:
The 3D object benchmark comprises 100 100 Three.js generation prompts stratified across three specification levels— 21 21 concise ( simple ), 17 17 moderate ( medium ), and 62 62 richly specified ( detailed ) prompts—testing synthesis across varying levels of structural and stylistic complexity without prescribing explicit metric dimensions or part lists.
All systems are evaluated under a uniform single-request deliverable protocol : each workflow receives the identical user prompt string and delivers a final executable program, which is rebuilt and scored by our common evaluator.
For commercial product baselines such as Claude Design (powered by Claude Opus 5.5), we evaluate its released reference outputs directly in our unified evaluation pipeline without modification.
blocks.zh:
3D对象基准包括100 100 3.js生成分三个规格级的分级:21 21个简洁(简洁),17个中度(中度),以及62个明确(详细)的分级分级-在结构和结构复杂程度的不同级别进行综合测试,但没有规定明确的尺度或部分清单。
所有系统都根据统一的单一请求可交付协议进行评估:每个工作流程都收到相同的用户提示字符串,并交付最终可执行程序,由我们的共同评价者重建并打分.
对于Claude Design等商业产品基线(由Claude Opus 5.5驱动),我们直接在统一评价程序内对其释放的参考产出进行评估,不作修改。

blocks.en:
We evaluate Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Opus 5.5 against their respective native baselines on the primary 60 60 -prompt benchmark, and evaluate Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-6 Luna, and GPT-6 Astra on a balanced 30 30 -prompt subset ( 10 10 prompts per specification level).
Each native baseline (Table 13 ) synthesizes code in a single pass using its standard coding-agent backend (high reasoning effort for Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5; medium effort for GPT-6 Astra; direct API for Gemini 3.8 Flash), whereas 3DCodeVerse Harness wraps the identical backbone model with structured planning, spatial tools, and automated verification.
This paired design directly isolates the end-to-end gain of the 3DCodeVerse Harness workflow for a fixed backbone model, with token telemetry and API-equivalent cost reported alongside quality metrics (Table 7 ).

我们根据各自在60-即时基准上的本国基准对双子座3.8 Flash和Claude Opus 5.5进行评估,并对Claude Sonnet 5、GPT-6 Luna和GPT-6 Astra进行平衡的30-即时子集(每规格级10个即时)的评估。
每个本土基线(表13)使用其标准编码代理后端(Claude Opus 5.5和Sonnet 5的高度推理努力;GPT-6 Astra的中度努力;双子座3.8 Flash的直接API)合成单通码,而3DCode Verse Harness用结构化规划,空间工具,以及自动化验证,将相同的主干模型包裹起来.
这种配对设计直接隔离了固定主干模型3DCodeVerse Harness工作流程的端到端收益,在质量度量衡的同时报告有符号遥测和API等价(表7).

blocks.en:
The single-request protocol prohibits human-in-the-loop intervention: each system receives one user prompt with zero subsequent human edits or manual candidate cherry-picking, while permitting autonomous internal tool calls and verification passes.
Our primary object benchmark evaluates single-round harness execution ( T = 0 T=0 in the notation of § 4 ), retaining the initial planned generation, interactive tool use, automated build repair, and final verification (using Gemini 3.8 Flash as planner and Gemini 3.1 Pro as in-loop judge for the Flash runs).
Multi-round studies ( T = 4 T=4 ) extend this autonomous loop with up to four closed-loop refinement rounds and automated post-run output selection under the same single user request.

我们的首要目标基准是评价单轮牵引装置的执行(T=0 T=0,注解为§4),保留最初计划的生成,交互式工具的使用,自动化的建筑修复,以及最后的校验(使用双子座 3.8 Flash作为计划员,双子座 3.1 Pro作为闪光跑的即时裁判).
多轮研究(T = 4 T = 4)延长了这个自发循环,最多可有4个闭路改进回合和在同一单一用户请求下自动运行后输出选择.

blocks.en:
All Judge Scores and VLM Preferences reported in § 5 are produced by a single frozen evaluation pipeline that applies the judgment architecture and track rubrics of Appendix A.4 independently of the generation workflow under test.
Each delivered program is rebuilt from scratch in its pinned runtime, with failed builds scored zero, to extract geometric measurements, connectivity or kinematic-sweep telemetry, and canonical multi-view renders (fourteen shaded views plus clay views for objects, multi-pose sweeps for articulated mechanisms, authored and orbital views at two timestamps for scenes, and sampled frame sheets for graphics); Gemini 3.1 Pro then scores it three times.
Three safeguards decouple evaluation from in-loop refinement:
(1) clean-room rebuild and blind prompting , scoring every artifact against the raw user prompt and a prompt-derived checklist alone, with all harness-generated plans, internal checklists, and refinement histories stripped;
(2) deterministic geometric caps , bounding scores via exact mesh connectivity and kinematic checks independent of VLM perception (Eq. 5 ); and
(3) multi-metric validation , pairing Judge Scores with SigLIP-2 similarity and blind human pairwise preferences (§ 5 ), which consistently corroborate the rubric gains across all four tracks.

Our primary metric, the overall Judge Score S all S_{\mathrm{all}} (Table 13 ), combines seven weighted object criteria—intent fidelity ( 0.22 0.22 ), structural plausibility ( 0.18 0.18 ), geometry detail ( 0.16 0.16 ), proportions and scale ( 0.12 0.12 ), assembly fit ( 0.12 0.12 ), materials ( 0.10 0.10 ), and craftsmanship ( 0.10 0.10 )—with deterministic defect penalties and caps (Eq. 5 ).
To verify that our gains over external baselines such as Claude Design do not stem merely from metric-scale conventions or hard structural caps on open-ended prompts, we additionally compute an uncapped, scale-free visual score in Tables 6 and 8 : S vis = ∑ k ≠ scale w k ​ s k ∑ k ≠ scale w k , S_{\mathrm{vis}}=\frac{\sum_{k\neq\mathrm{scale}}w_{k}s_{k}}{\sum_{k\neq\mathrm{scale}}w_{k}}, (7) which aggregates raw criterion means s k s_{k} prior to aggregate defect penalties and score caps while excluding the proportions-and-scale criterion (with failed builds scored zero on both metrics).
Even under this forgiving, uncapped metric, 3DCodeVerse Harness outperforms Claude Design by + 25.6 +25.6 points ( 88.1 88.1 vs. 62.4 62.4 , winning 58 58 of 60 60 prompts), confirming that its advantage reflects superior geometric fidelity and visual craftsmanship rather than rubric thresholding.

Both human and VLM pairwise evaluations present the original user prompt alongside anonymized multi-view renders captured under matched camera poses, framing, and resolution.
Evaluators judge overall preference on prompt adherence, structural plausibility, and visual craftsmanship, with ties counted as half a win; VLM preference additionally requires agreement across both presentation orders (§ A.4 ).
Human evaluations randomize left/right presentation order across a fixed, pre-registered prompt subset shared by all compared systems, with prompt-level bootstrap confidence intervals clustering repeated ratings at the task level.
In end-to-end preference reporting, a valid executable artifact wins against a failed build and two failed builds tie, while conditional preference over mutually executing pairs is tracked alongside execution rate; transient provider outages are excluded from win/loss tallies.

These gains generalize across tracks (Table 8 ): 3DCodeVerse Harness yields large improvements on procedural graphics for GPT-6 Astra ( + 30.4 +30.4 points, 10 10 – 1 1 W/L/T), Gemini 3.8 Flash ( + 27.2 +27.2 , 10 10 – 1 1 ), and GPT-6 Luna ( + 6.8 +6.8 , 8 8 – 3 3 ), as well as on 3D scenes for Flash ( + 19.4 +19.4 , 9 9 – 1 1 ) and Luna ( + 14.6 +14.6 , 7 7 – 0 0 ).

Independent generation runs on open-ended prompts naturally explore diverse structural decompositions: in an A/A study across six paired runs with early pass stopping (Table 9 ; σ Δ = 0.202 \sigma_{\Delta}=0.202 ), as well as a 12 12 -pair articulated study with a fixed plan ( Δ ¯ = − 0.046 \bar{\Delta}=-0.046 , σ Δ = 0.225 \sigma_{\Delta}=0.225 , 2 ​ SE = ± 0.130 2\,\text{SE}=\pm 0.130 ), a single prompt may be realized either as a compact monolithic mesh ( 1 1 part, 4,796 4{,}796 triangles) or as a fine-grained multi-part assembly ( 10 10 parts, 61,340 61{,}340 triangles).
This structural diversity motivates two core design choices in our work:
(1) within 3DCodeVerse Harness, best-of- N N candidate initialization and multi-round refinement (§ A.5 ) hedge against single-rollout topological variance; and
(2) in our experimental design, while full-workflow gains of + 0.15 +0.15 to + 0.49 +0.49 are cleanly resolved on 30 30 – 60 60 paired prompts, fine-grained infrastructure optimizations are evaluated directly via high-power event-level telemetry across hundreds to thousands of invocations (§ C.5 ).

这种结构多样性推动了我们工作中的两个核心设计选择:
(1) 在3DCodeVerse Harness、N型最优候选初始化和多轮改进(§A.5)范围内对接单一推出的地形差异;
(2) 在我们的实验设计中,虽然30-60个对接的导出上,30-60个对接的导出上,0.15+0.15至+0.49的全工作流增益得到干净的解决,但精细的精细的基础设施优化则通过数百至上千个引用的高功率事件级遥测直接进行评估(§C.5).

blocks.en:
Each preference signal targets a distinct aspect of code generation quality:
(1) Execution-feedback DPO substantially increases single-sample reliability and multi-sample coverage: on the 9B ( 5.2 5.2 K) checkpoint, two rounds of execution DPO lift greedy 3DCodeBench execution from 75.0 % 75.0\% to 96.2% and raise four-seed union pass@4 ( T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 ) from 91.0 % 91.0\% to 99.1% (Table 12 ).
On the flagship 27B ( 104 104 K) checkpoint, execution DPO preserves top 3DCodeBench execution ( 92.9% at T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 ) while achieving the highest overall geometric fidelity on both 3DCodeBench (F@0.05 of 0.374 ) and Blender ( 93.2% execution, 0.798 F@0.05) and lifting OpenSCAD execution by + 18.0 +18.0 pp (from 72.0 % 72.0\% to 90.0% ; Table 10 ).
(2) Geometry-feedback DPO directly refines 3D shape fidelity once execution is saturated: on the 9B ( 270 270 K) checkpoint, it lifts conditional F@0.05 from 0.387 0.387 to 0.403 while achieving a 98.1 % 98.1\% pass@4 execution rate (Table 12 ).
(3) Termination-feedback DPO eliminates repetitive brace-closing loops under greedy decoding.
Pairing non-terminating greedy outputs with the model’s shortest valid completion for the same training prompt across two lightweight DPO rounds ( 1,779 1{,}779 and 478 478 pairs) compresses mean OpenSCAD output length from 30,163 30{,}163 to 2,884 2{,}884 tokens and drives greedy execution from 8.0 % 8.0\% to 86.0% ( + 78.0 +78.0 pp) on OpenSCAD, from 59.0 % 59.0\% to 89.5% ( + 30.5 +30.5 pp) on GLSL, and from 79.2 % 79.2\% to 84.9% on 3DCodeBench .

Comparing single-dialect and multi-dialect training mixtures reveals strong cross-language transfer alongside clear mixture-design principles:
(1) Cross-dialect transfer : joint multi-dialect training boosts CadQuery execution to 98.0% , compared with 73.0 % 73.0\% under single-dialect training.
(2) Target-dialect upsampling : increasing the Blender share of the 9B mixture from 15 % 15\% to 34 % 34\% (Table 5 , 116 116 K balanced) raises held-out Blender F@0.05 from 0.705 0.705 to 0.816 (with failed builds scored zero) and lifts greedy OpenSCAD execution from 4 % 4\% to 56 % 56\% .
(3) Capacity and mixture balance for long-horizon scripts : while isolated fine-tuning of a 9B checkpoint on 280 280 long multi-part Three.js programs approaches the sequence window and induces non-termination, combining balanced multi-dialect supervision with larger capacity in the 27B ( 104 104 K) mixture elevates Three.js execution from 72.5 % 72.5\% to 92.5% (Table 10 ).

比较单向和多相分辨培训混合物,可发现在明确混合设计原则的同时,强有力的跨语言转移:
(1)交叉分流:联合多分流培训将CadQuery被处决率提高到98.0%,而单分流培训中的比例为73.0%。
(2) 目标分辨抽样:将9B混合物的Blender比例从15%-15%-%提高到34%-34-%(表5,116-116 K平衡),将被搁置的Blender F@0.05从0.705 0.705提高到了0.816(失败的建筑得分为零),并将贪婪的OpenSCAD执行率从4%-%提高到56%-56-%。
(3) 长视距脚本的能力和混合物平衡:在280个长相280个多部分的3.js程序上对9B检查点进行单独微调时,接近序列窗口并诱导不终止,同时将平衡多分光监督与27B(104 104 K)混合物中更大的容量相结合,将3.js的执行率从72.5%的72.5%提高到92.5%(表10)。

blocks.en:
Complementing the robotics application in § 6 , we examine how executable 3D code preserves rigid-link structure during robot manipulation compared with a frozen video world-action model, UWM ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
Using an articulated microwave asset synthesized by GPT-6 Astra and verified by 3DCodeVerse Harness tooling (passing forward-kinematics, rigid-distance, and hinge-sweep gates across five poses), we instantiate a MuJoCo simulation alongside the native reference asset across two initial contact states and three robot control sequences— contact push , hold , and retreat —yielding 12 12 evaluation cases.
Each rollout executes 16 16 matched robot action commands at 20 20 Hz: UWM generates three seeded video rollouts per case ( 36 36 total) from observation history and action commands, whereas code simulation steps the explicit articulated asset directly inside MuJoCo.
blocks.zh:
作为第6节中机器人应用的补充,我们考察了可执行的3D代码如何在机器人操纵期间与被冻结的视频世界动作模型UWM(Zhu等,2025年)相比保留了刚性链接结构.
利用由GPT-6 Astra合成并由3DCodeVerse Harness工具验证的精密微波资产(跨越前缘、僵硬相距和连接相接的门,跨越5个外观),我们与本地参考资产一起,在两个初始接触国和三个机器人控制序列——接触推力、控住和后退——一起进行模拟,得出12个评价案例。
每次推出在20赫兹执行16个16个匹配的机器人动作指令:UWM从观测历史和动作指令中每个案例产生出3个种子视频推出(共36个36个),而代码模拟则直接在MuJoCo内部对明确表达的资产进行步骤.

blocks.en:
To measure whether rollouts maintain coherent rigid-part geometry under physical interaction, we apply a calibrated orientation-aware door-and-handle contour detector across all outputs.
Calibrated prior to evaluation on 24 24 held-out static renders across six hinge angles and four robot poses, the detector recovers the true hinge angle within 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} on all 20 20 accepted detections and abstains whenever contours degrade or become ambiguous.
To isolate latent dynamics drift from autoencoder reconstruction blur, we additionally evaluate a VAE-reconstructed code control by passing every simulator render through UWM’s frozen VAE encoder and decoder.
Across all 72 72 evaluated outputs (Table 17 ), both direct code simulation and VAE-reconstructed code renders satisfy the geometric criterion in 12/12 (100%) rollouts, whereas UWM predictions satisfy the criterion in only 7/36 (19.4%) rollouts ( 29 / 36 29/36 fail to preserve assessable door-and-handle contours).
Because passing code renders through UWM’s own frozen VAE preserves a 12 / 12 12/12 pass rate, the contour degradation in UWM rollouts stems from latent action dynamics rather than VAE reconstruction limits.
blocks.zh:
为了衡量推广是否在物理相互作用下保持了连贯的刚性部分几何,我们在所有输出物中都采用了有校准的定向感知门和手相轮廓探测器。
在对24个24个被挡住的静态进行校正之前, 探测器在6个连接角和4个机器人的姿势之间, 在所有20个被接受的探测中,
为了将潜在的动态漂移从自动编码器重建模糊中分离出来,我们通过UWM所冻结的VAE编码器和解码器,通过每一个模拟器的渲染,来进一步评估一个由VAE重建的编码控制。
在所有72项评估产出中(表17),直接代码模拟和VAE重构编码都满足了12/12(100%)推出时的几何标准,而UWM预测仅满足7/36(19.4%)推出时的标准(29/36 29/36未能保持可评估的门和手轮廓)。
由于通过代码让UWM自己的被冻结的VAE保持了12/12的通过率,UWM推出时的轮廓退化源于潜在的动作动态而不是VAE重建极限.

blocks.en:
Table 17 and Figures 16 – 17 clarify the structural advantage of programmatic 3D assets for embodied simulation.
While a static last-frame baseline trivially preserves initial contours ( 12 / 12 12/12 ) by predicting zero motion, pixel-space world models synthesize motion directly in latent space at the cost of frequent contour distortion across random seeds.
By contrast, compiling generated 3D code into a physics simulator combines both properties: the simulator enforces exact rigid-body transformations, joint axes, and articulated state transitions over time while maintaining crisp, view-consistent geometry across contact push, hold, and retreat controls.
blocks.zh:
表17和图16 - 17澄清了方案三维资产在结构上的优势,用于体现模拟。
虽然静态后帧基线通过预测零运动而微乎其微地保留了初始轮廓(12 / 12 12/12),但像素-空间世界模型在潜在空间直接合成了运动,而牺牲了随机种子间频繁的轮廓扭曲.
相形之下,将生成的3D代码编译为物理模拟器,将两种属性结合起来:模拟器执行精确的刚体转换,联合轴,以及随着时间推移而清晰的状态过渡,同时保持简洁,相容的几何图形跨越接触推力,牵制和后退控制.
